findings.message: The requirement to move author unchanged contradicts the requirement that the helper starts no process: author calls tests.approval.approve, which runs git.
findings.paved_road: Allow author to change so approval uses an in-memory seam, and specify the expected approval behavior for callers.

findings.message: Keeping author's body unchanged while eliminating its real git invocation requires changing its approval helper, which is outside the scope fence.
findings.paved_road: Fence and specify changes to the approval helper, or permit changing author to use an existing fake-based approval seam.
